Then the 40T's power cost is someone else's problem — the sats are all yours. $799, 40 TH/s, and it draws a real block ticket every ten minutes for years.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

With free power, run it in Turbo: 50 TH/s at 850 W, same $799 — that's $16 a terahash, the best value we sell. Batch 6 is live, ships November 21, 2026.

What's in the fleet now, so I don't sell you a duplicate?
1 antminer z15, 2 antminer z9 minis, 4 bitaxe gamma 601s, 1 innosilicon s11

No duplicate there — the Z15 and Z9s are Equihash, the S11's its own coin, so your only SHA-256 is about 5 TH of Bitaxes. One 40T in Turbo is roughly ten times your whole Bitcoin hashrate, same desk, same free power.

Want me to put one in the cart?
